preamble: Children's coloring-book sticker art. Pure black outline (#231F20) of thick, perfectly uniform weight on a pure white background. Absolutely NO color fill, no shading, no gray, no hatching, no texture, no shadow, no ground line, no background elements, no text. Every shape fully closed with no gaps. Very few large simple shapes so a 3-year-old can tap each region: big round head, chubby short-limbed body. Big round solid-black eyes with one small white highlight, tiny solid-black nose, soft smile; warm, adorable, friendly. Style: Khan Academy Kids / Duck Duck Moose picture book, rounded organic shapes. Each subject centered in a square image with generous white margin.
